semantics.q: effective per-effort probability of at least one detection conditional on site occupancy
semantics.effort_unit: trap deployment / trap-equivalent within the standardized overnight monitoring abstraction

source_grounded_constraints: Washington Sea Grant Crab Team standard monitoring uses six baited traps per event: three Fukui and three minnow traps, typically over one nighttime high tide.
Published early-detection work supports the qualitative claim that greater trapping effort materially improves detection and that low-effort non-detection is weak evidence.
Available trap-catchability and trap-entry estimates are not the same estimand as site-level occupancy-conditional q in this project.

identifiability.reason: site-month totals lack same-occasion trap-level replicate detection histories under a defensible occupancy-closure assumption

benchmark_design_support.selection_semantics: engineering scenario support spanning weak/moderate/strong evidence; not an empirical biological prior

information_firewall: q_true must not appear in GraphState
q_true must not appear in planner constraints
q_true must not appear in field-observation metadata
planner may only react to posterior belief quantities produced by the explicit Bayesian engine
claim_guardrail: The numeric q values above are benchmark scenario anchors, not estimated green-crab site-detection probabilities.
